The '''Hardwood Fence''' is a [[Crafting#Fences|craftable]] item that allows players to block off certain areas of [[The Farm]]. It lasts for 502 to 505 days.  It can also be purchased from the [[Casino]] for {{Price|100|Qi}} (={{Price|1000}}).
